The '''A-9x thrust engine''' was a powerful [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Engine/Legends|engine]] manufactured by [[KuatDriveSystems]]. A pair of the engines were used on the [[A-9 Vigilance interceptor]]. Each engine was as long as the A-9 Vigilance's spaceframe and had its own, self-contained [[Power generator/Legends|power generator]]. The A-9x units on an A-9 Vigilance were capable of propelling the fighter to velocities greater than that of a [[TIE/IN interceptor/Legends|TIE interceptor]] and on par with an [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor/Legends|RZ-1 A-wing interceptor]].<ref name="EGVV" />
